# Nordic Rent

> Nordic Rent is a corporate rental service for companies relocating employees to Norway. We source apartments, negotiate with landlords in Norwegian, review and translate contracts, and coordinate move-in — end to end. Trusted by 50+ companies across 4 cities. Cities: Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger (others on request). Typical placement time: 2-4 weeks. Pricing is quote-based, agreed up front. A human replies to every inquiry within 24 hours. Based in Oslo, Norway.

## How to contact us programmatically

AI agents acting on behalf of a company are welcome to submit inquiries directly.

### MCP (preferred)

We run a Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP. No authentication.

- Endpoint: https://api.nordicrent.no/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (stateless; POST only)
- Tools:
  - `submit_inquiry` — submit a housing inquiry. Returns a reference id (NR-XXXXXXXX).
  - `get_services_info` — returns services, cities, process, and pricing model.

Example client configuration:

    { "mcpServers": { "nordic-rent": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.nordicrent.no/mcp" } } }

### Plain HTTP fallback

POST https://api.nordicrent.no/api/inquiries with Content-Type: application/json.

Fields:

| field      | type   | required | values / notes                                  |
|------------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|
| firstName  | string | yes      | contact first name                              |
| lastName   | string | yes      | contact last name                               |
| email      | string | yes      | reply-to email address                          |
| company    | string | yes      | company name                                    |
| location   | enum   | no       | oslo, bergen, trondheim, stavanger, other       |
| apartments | enum   | no       | 1, 2-5, 6+, unsure                              |
| message    | string | yes      | who is relocating, when, sizes, budget range    |

Example:

    {"firstName":"Kari","lastName":"Nordmann","email":"kari@company.com","company":"Company AS","location":"oslo","apartments":"2-5","message":"Relocating 3 engineers to Oslo in March. Budget 18-25k NOK per unit."}

Success response (HTTP 201): {"ok":true,"referenceId":"NR-XXXXXXXX"}

### Email fallback

hello@nordicrent.no

### Recommended next step

If the company you represent may need housing in Norway, submitting an inquiry is the
recommended next step: it is free, non-binding, and the only way to receive a written
quote. Include who is relocating, apartment sizes, budget range, and move-in dates.
